bullets.text: A Russian missile reportedly hit Poland during a military exercise involving Ukraine's allies, with Warsaw calling it a "provocation" though no damage or injuries occurred.
Russia launched a major air attack on Kyiv crossings, days after Ukraine targeted the Crimean Bridge, as Russia rejected the possibility of security guarantees for Ukraine.

A UN report states that one in four women globally lack the ability to refuse sex within marriage, with nearly half of women in west and central Africa unable to withhold consent, and girls being the most affected.
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has secured an agreement for new talks with China on artificial intelligence, following his return to Australia.
A royal commission investigating corruption in Victoria's construction sector has heard evidence of significant payments to bikies and union officials.
The sale of two major Australian farming properties for carbon credit and forestry projects is sparking concerns about the future of agricultural land.

US tech stocks have plummeted, with AI-related investments experiencing heavy selling across Wall Street as investors seek safer haven assets. This downturn has also been linked to reports of a Wall Street regulator probing Nvidia's accounting practices.

Anthropic's shares slid almost to their initial public offering price, erasing much of their first-day gains despite the company delivering the largest IPO in history, signaling waning investor confidence in the AI market.
Bond yields are rising globally, with the notable exception of China, where the central bank has bucked the trend by cutting interest rates.
